event.title: Kick-Start Your Success
event.description: The welcome and introductory programme for all new Heriot-Watt students starting taught postgraduate study.
programmeOutline: Find out the distinctive features of being a postgraduate student at Heriot-Watt University.
Develop essential academic skills for success in your degree.
Discover resources like IT, Library, and myHWU Student Portal.
Chat with current students about their experiences.
Get tips on wellbeing, careers, and extracurriculars.
eligibility: Open to all students starting a Heriot-Watt taught postgraduate programme in January at Edinburgh and Scottish Borders Campuses.

event.title: Get Ready for Success @ HWU
event.description: Heriot-Watt University is committed to widening participation in higher education. This event offers the opportunity for university study to students from a diverse range of backgrounds who have the potential to succeed.
programmeOutline: Meet and talk to current students and find out from them what university is really like.
Develop and put into practice some of the academic skills that are essential for success in your degree.
Find out about resources (IT, Library, myHWU Student Portal etc.) that you will need for university.
Find out essential tips for survival: finding your way around, managing time/money, and using the Careers Service.
event.contactInfo: If you are not in one of the groups above but think you might benefit, please contact studentsuccess@hw.ac.uk.

registration.label: Register for Get Ready For Success 2026

eligibility: Students from the 40% most deprived neighbourhoods in Scotland (SIMD).
Students from schools with comparatively low rates of progression to higher education.
Students joining year 2 or 3 of a degree after completing an HNC or HND.
Mature students who have completed a SWAP Access course.
Students who have formerly been looked after or in foster care.
Anyone who cares, unpaid, for a friend or family member due to illness/disability.
Anyone under 25 without family support (estranged students).
Former UK armed forces personnel, reservists, or their families.
Participants in the Transitions Event (Mon 31 Aug - Tue 1 Sept 2026).
